## 2. Global Summary
- `topic`: Armv7-M Architecture Reference Manual defining the Microcontroller profile of Armv7, application-level and system-level programmers models, memory model, Thumb instruction set, instruction encodings, instruction semantics, debug architecture, appendices, pseudocode and register indexes.
- `module_scope`: Application architecture, Thumb/Thumb-2 instructions, floating-point and DSP extensions, exception model, SCS/NVIC/SysTick/MPU/CPUID system registers, memory barriers, debug components including DAP/ITM/DWT/TPIU/FPB, CoreSight infrastructure IDs, pseudocode language and glossary.
